name: inaturalist-mcp-server
description: Global citizen-science biodiversity observations from iNaturalist — sightings, photos, identification threads, phenology, similar species, annotations, places, and projects via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Global citizen-science biodiversity observations from iNaturalist via MCP.
interface.longDescription: Provides tools for querying iNaturalist — wildlife sightings with photos, the community identification thread behind each record, per-taxon phenology, similar-species confusion data, annotations, places, projects, and observer leaderboards.
